description: Search Google Maps and get one row per place: phone, website, address, rating, and hours.

tool_signatures.name: search_google_maps_places
tool_signatures.description: Search Google Maps or look up known place IDs. Returns one row per place with name, phone, website, address, coordinates, categories, rating, review count, hours, and attributes.

search_terms.description: What to search on Google Maps, such as dentist in Austin, TX. One search per entry. Each search returns up to about 120 to 200 places, so split a large area into neighborhoods.

places.description: Optional. Look up places you already know: a ChIJ place ID, or a Google Maps place URL. Each costs one place row.

max_places_per_search.description: Whole number from 1 to 500. Default 20. Google stops most searches between 120 and 200 places.

only_country.description: Optional 2 letter country code, such as DE. Places in other countries are dropped and not charged. A search for Berlin can otherwise return Berlin, New Jersey, on later pages.

dedupe.description: yes or no. Default yes: a place found twice in a run is returned and charged once.

language.description: Language code for names and categories, such as en or de. Default en.

results_country.description: 2 letter code Google uses to tailor results. Default us. It does not limit results to that country; use only_country for that.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.
